channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: A day after the election selloff priced regulatory risk into neoclouds, the stack repriced delivery and list rates. Bloomberg via Reuters said Microsoft is tightening oversight of projects at Nebius, IREN and Nscale and debating new neocloud contracts as it prioritises owned sites; IREN's Q1 put its >$4 billion ARR target into January 2027 after a Microsoft-requested network redesign at Childress. Hyperscalers are still converting land into campuses they control: Google posted a $17 billion first Wyoming data centre with a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell CCS plant, Amazon confirmed a Somervell County campus as a direct Comanche Peak nuclear offtaker, and TeraWulf locked Fluor EPC plus a Google credit backstop for Anthropic's ~401 MW Justified lease in Kentucky. On the public tape, Lambda raised 8x on-demand prints overnight — B200 $6.69 to $7.69, H100 $3.99 to $4.59, A100-80GB $2.79 to $3.19, GH200 $2.29 to $2.59 — while CoreWeave H100 held $6.16 and Crusoe's 1 December column stayed scheduled, not live. Tape: 66 confirms, 4 ticks, 0 NEW.

item.title: Compute brief - 6 November 2026
item.description: A day after the election selloff priced regulatory risk into neoclouds, the stack repriced delivery and list rates. Bloomberg via Reuters said Microsoft is tightening oversight of projects at Nebius, IREN and Nscale and debating new neocloud contracts as it prioritises owned sites; IREN's Q1 put its >$4 billion ARR target into January 2027 after a Microsoft-requested network redesign at Childress. Hyperscalers are still converting land into campuses they control: Google posted a $17 billion first Wyoming data centre with a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell CCS plant, Amazon confirmed a Somervell County campus as a direct Comanche Peak nuclear offtaker, and TeraWulf locked Fluor EPC plus a Google credit backstop for Anthropic's ~401 MW Justified lease in Kentucky. On the public tape, Lambda raised 8x on-demand prints overnight — B200 $6.69 to $7.69, H100 $3.99 to $4.59, A100-80GB $2.79 to $3.19, GH200 $2.29 to $2.59 — while CoreWeave H100 held $6.16 and Crusoe's 1 December column stayed scheduled, not live. Tape: 66 confirms, 4 ticks, 0 NEW. Countries: United States: Google's first Wyoming data centre: $17 billion long-term, 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell plant with CCS, air-cooled (Wire, 5 Nov). United States: Amazon confirms Somervell County campus on Vistra land next to Comanche Peak; direct nuclear offtaker, site prep underway (Wire, 5 Nov). United States: TeraWulf Justified (Hawesville, KY): Fluor EPC, Anthropic ~401 MW / ~$19B lease, Google credit backstop; RFS late 2027–Q2 2028 (Wire, 6 Nov). United States: Microsoft tightens Nebius/IREN/Nscale oversight; IREN >$4B ARR slips to Jan 2027 on network redesign (Bloomberg/Reuters, IREN IR, 5–6 Nov). United States: ERCOT Community Impact RFI: 433 of 465 loads replied covering ~177 GW; final report targeted 10 Dec (PUC deck, 5 Nov). India: IndiaAI 10,000-GPU round still closes 13 Nov IST; no award yet (prior Wire).
